label: Amazon Fire TV / Prime Video Streaming TV Ads
terms_note: Covered by the Amazon Ads API onboarding (approved application required)

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Login with Amazon; Amazon Ads API credentials + profile scope)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** via the Amazon Ads API **Sponsored TV** endpoints (self-serve streaming TV); reserved Prime Video /

endpoints.call: Sponsored TV › Campaign (list / create / update / delete)
endpoints.notes: name, state, budget{budget, budgetType}, startDate, endDate
assetType VIDEO, fileName, upload url; creative {assetId, landingPage}
configuration{reportTypeId, groupBy, columns, timeUnit DAILY}, startDate, endDate

endpoints.purpose: not in the STV surface (Amazon attribution is native)

reference.limits: - Per-endpoint throttling (429, Retry-After). Eligibility: Sponsored TV available to advertisers in supported marketplaces; brand registry / product requirements apply (TODO(verify)). Free API.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Login with Amazon client id of the app approved for the Amazon Ads API; also sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-ClientId header.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The LWA client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: LWA refresh token from the advertiser's consent (scope advertising::campaign_management); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it at https://api.amazon.com/auth/o2/token.

config_fields.name: api_host
config_fields.help: Regional Amazon Ads API host: advertising-api.amazon.com (North America), advertising-api-eu.amazon.com (Europe) or advertising-api-fe.amazon.com (Far East).

config_fields.name: profile_id
config_fields.help: Advertising profile id of the advertiser running Sponsored TV (from GET /v2/profiles), sent as the Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope header.

me.note: GET /v2/profiles/{profileId}: the configured profile {profileId, countryCode, currencyCode, timezone, accountInfo {id, type, name, marketplaceStringId}}.

list_accounts.note: GET /v2/profiles (apiProgram=campaign, accessLevel=edit by default): one profile per advertiser and marketplace in the configured region. `id` is the profileId used as the Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope; country is raw.countryCode.

list_campaigns.note: Sponsored TV (Fire TV / Prime Video streaming TV ads) POST /st/campaigns/list with media type application/vnd.stCampaign.v1+json and {maxResults, stateFilter: {include: [status]}} (ENABLED, PAUSED, ARCHIVED). The advertiser is the configured profile_id (Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope); account_id is not sent. `budget` is the DAILY budget. Only the first page is returned (nextToken paging).

update_budget.note: PUT /st/campaigns {campaigns: [{campaignId, budgetSettings: {budget: {budgetValue: {amount, budgetCurrencyCode}, recurrenceType: DAILY}}}]}: changes a daily budget that is spent on streaming TV ads. The API answers 207 with campaigns.success[] / campaigns.error[]; a rejected update is reported as invalid_input.

pause_resume.note: PUT /st/campaigns {campaigns: [{campaignId, state: PAUSED|ENABLED}]}. Resuming restarts spending. A rejected update (campaigns.error only) is reported as invalid_input.

not_offered.get_report: Amazon Ads reporting is asynchronous: "POST /reporting/reports" creates a report job that is polled with "GET /reporting/reports/{reportId}" and downloaded from a URL (Amazon Ads API Postman collection, https://github.com/amzn/ads-advanced-tools-docs, Reporting); the runtime has no report polling.
